title: Verify: Markdown contribution store and path sanitizer unit tests
summary: Unit tests proving each contribution becomes a distinct Markdown file and traversal is rejected.
description: Unit tests written from the requirement spec with mocked Git, clock and temp-dir filesystem only. Context: each contribution becomes a distinct Markdown file; traversal is rejected. Expected result: all listed tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given two concurrent Save calls, when both complete, then two different files exist and each contains its own prompt
Given an existing file for an ID, when Save would write it again, then the write fails and the file is unchanged
Given a worldID or roundID containing .., a slash or a backslash, when Save runs, then safepath.ErrUnsafe is returned and nothing is written
Given a saved contribution, when Get(id) and ListByPlayer run, then the stored fields are returned

preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI
definition_of_done: Listed tests pass via the unit command

steps.action: Write test TestSave_ConcurrentDistinctFiles: t.TempDir root, fake Committer recording calls; 50 goroutines call Save with different prompts; assert 50 distinct .md files under worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/round-0000001/contributions and 50 commits.
Write test TestSave_NoOverwrite: Save with preset ID twice; second returns an error and file content equals the first prompt.
Write test TestSave_TraversalRejected: WorldID "../x" and RoundID "a/b" return safepath.ErrUnsafe; temp dir stays empty.
Write table test TestSegment: "..", "a/b", "a\\b", "" and a 65-char string return ErrUnsafe; "ROUND-0000001" and "the-boys-room" return nil.
Write test TestGetAndListByPlayer: Save two contributions for different players; Get returns the exact fields; ListByPlayer returns one.
